## Raspberry Pi board
Generated using the built-in image generation tool for this project. It is a visual illustration, not a pinout or manufacturing reference. A separate data-driven overlay supplies exactly 40 accurately labeled GPIO pins.
Prompt: Photorealistic Raspberry Pi 4 Model B, directly overhead orthographic view, green PCB, GPIO header at top, USB and Ethernet at right, full board visible, clean white background, no interface or added labels.
Raspberry Pi names and marks belong to their respective owners. This is an independent learning project.
